name: Palworld ARM64 - Pterodactyl FEX v2
author: admin@ballaual.de
description: Wings-native Palworld ARM64 image. Uses Supersunho's FEX and Python manager but bypasses the incompatible upstream Docker entrypoint that hardcodes /home/steam. All mutable state is under /home/container.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

ROOT="/mnt/server"
DD="/opt/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader"
STEAM_SEED="/opt/steamcmd-seed"
APP_ID="${SRCDS_APPID:-2394010}"

step() {
    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "$1"
    echo "============================================================"
}

fatal() {
    echo "[FATAL] $1"
    exit "${2:-1}"
}

step "[1/5] Checking ARM64 environment"
echo "Architecture: $(uname -m)"
echo "Kernel:       $(uname -r)"
df -h "${ROOT}" || true

case "$(uname -m)" in
    aarch64|arm64) ;;
    *) fatal "This egg requires an ARM64/aarch64 node." 10 ;;
esac

[[ -x "${DD}" ]] || fatal "Native ARM64 DepotDownloader is missing from the custom image." 11

step "[2/5] Preparing Pterodactyl server volume"
mkdir -p \
    "${ROOT}/backups" \
    "${ROOT}/logs/palworld" \
    "${ROOT}/.steamcmd" \
    "${ROOT}/Steam" \
    "${ROOT}/tmp" \
    "${ROOT}/.cache" \
    "${ROOT}/.config" \
    "${ROOT}/.local/share" \
    "${ROOT}/Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer"

step "[3/5] Installing Palworld Dedicated Server"
ARGS=(
    -app "${APP_ID}"
    -os linux
    -osarch 64
    -dir "${ROOT}"
    -validate
)

if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(-branch "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
fi
if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(-branchpassword "${SRCDS_BETAPASS}")
fi

"${DD}" "${ARGS[@]}"

PALSERVER="${ROOT}/Pal/Binaries/Linux/PalServer-Linux-Shipping"
[[ -f "${PALSERVER}" ]] || fatal "Palworld executable was not downloaded to ${PALSERVER}" 12
chmod 0755 "${PALSERVER}" || true

step "[4/5] Seeding writable SteamCMD"
if [[ ! -x "${ROOT}/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh" ]]; then
    cp -a "${STEAM_SEED}/." "${ROOT}/.steamcmd/"
    chmod 0755 "${ROOT}/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh"
fi
[[ -x "${ROOT}/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh" ]] || fatal "SteamCMD seed failed." 13

step "[5/5] Final verification"
echo "Palworld: ${PALSERVER}"
echo "SteamCMD: ${ROOT}/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh"
df -h "${ROOT}" || true
echo
echo "Installation completed without package installation inside the Pterodactyl installer."

variables.name: Server Name

variables.description: Description displayed by the server.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional password players must enter to join.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Palworld admin and RCON password. CHANGE THIS before exposing the server.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Manager-side maximum players. Keep ServerPlayerMaxNum equal to this value.

variables.name: Server Player Max Num
variables.description: Value written to ServerPlayerMaxNum. Normally keep this equal to Maximum Players.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Optional public IPv4/hostname advertised by Palworld. Leave blank unless needed.

variables.name: Public Port
variables.description: Publicly advertised UDP game port. Keep this equal to the server's primary Pterodactyl allocation.

variables.name: Steam Query Port
variables.description: Steam server-query UDP port. Add this as an extra UDP allocation if you want server-browser/query traffic.

variables.name: Public Lobby
variables.description: Adds Palworld public-lobby startup behavior.

variables.name: Crossplay Platforms
variables.description: Platforms allowed to connect. Keep the surrounding parentheses.

variables.description: Periodically check whether a newer Palworld server version exists.
